one_line: The problem is equivalent up to a factor of three to the extremal problem for linear 3-graphs of Berge girth at least six, and an explicit moment-curve construction gives a lower bound Ω(n^{4/3}), leaving the exponent between 4/3 and 3/2.
caveats: No n^{3/2-o(1)} construction or fixed power-saving upper bound is obtained; the literature novelty of the 4/3 construction was not checked.
